memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'I will bless you. I will make your name great.'

sequence.prompt: How did God call Abram? Put it in order.

items.label: God said, 'Leave your home and go'
God promised to bless every family

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Called Abram and made a big promise
Packed the tents and the sheep

application.question: God asked Abram to go without telling him where. When is it hardest for you not to know what is coming?

options.label: When I am on my own

application.followUp: Abram did not know the road — but he knew the One who called him. You can know Him too, whatever is coming next.
